entities.summary: Emily Sandberg Gold is an American model and entrepreneur from Rochester, Minnesota. She was the international face of Clinique, Donna Karan, Versace, Fendi, and The Gap. She has also been featured on the covers of Vogue Italia, Vogue Japan, and Italian Marie Claire. In 2015 Gold became the founder and chief executive officer of digital marketing agency Twice Social, which has since rebranded as Gold Brand Consultants.
